parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The device name of the gateway.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID:
- Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
- Public instance: This parameter is not required.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway belongs. A ProductKey is the unique identifier of a product.
